map.基于碳氮比(C/N)平衡计算最佳还田量与补氮量，避免缺氮风险: Balance the C/N ratio to compute best return amount and nitrogen supplement, avoiding nitrogen deficit
map.秸秆 C/N = 碳% ÷ 氮%；目标总氮 = 总碳 ÷ 目标C/N；补氮量 =: Straw C/N = carbon% / nitrogen%; target total N = total carbon / target C/N; N supplement = max(0, target total N - straw N); fertilizer amount = N supplement / fertilizer N%
map.秸秆还田后微生物分解会与作物争氮，故需按目标碳氮比补氮。总碳 = 还田量 × 碳: After straw return, microbes decompose and compete with crops for nitrogen, so supplement N by the target C/N. Total carbon = return amount x carbon%, target total N reaches the set C/N (commonly 25); the shortfall divided by the chosen nitrogen fertilizer rate gives the supplement. Best return amount is advised by soil organic matter (more when poor, less when rich) with estimated decomposition days.
map.还田量 = 秸秆产量 × 还田比例，折算还田养分。: Return amount = straw yield x return ratio, converting returned nutrients.
map.按土壤承载力与下茬播种可行性定比例。: Set the ratio by soil capacity and next-crop sowing feasibility.
map.用于培肥与碳循环核算。: Used for fertility building and carbon-cycle accounting.
map.亩产秸秆 800 kg（干），还田比例 80%，则还田 640 kg/亩，约带入: Per-mu straw 800 kg (dry), return 80%, so 640 kg/mu, bringing about organic matter 540 kg, N 4.8 kg, P2O5 1.6 kg, K2O 6.4 kg. Partly replaces fertilizer but needs nitrogen to adjust C/N.
map.秸秆还田为什么要配氮肥？: Why add nitrogen with straw return?
map.秸秆碳氮比高（约 60~80:1），微生物分解争氮导致『与苗争氮』黄苗。还田时补: Straw C/N is high (about 60-80:1); microbes competing for nitrogen cause "nitrogen competition with seedlings" and yellowing. A little quick nitrogen at return (e.g., 5 kg/mu urea) eases it.
map.还田比例越高越好吗？: Is a higher return ratio better?
map.过高影响播种质量、地温与出苗，尤其冷凉区。一般 50%~80% 为宜，剩余离田能: Too high hurts sowing quality, soil temperature, and emergence, especially in cool areas. Generally 50%-80%; the rest goes off-field for energy/feed, balancing fertility and farming.
map.秸秆还田量优化器是一款农业种植领域的在线工具。农业种植工具，帮助计算种植参数与产: The Straw Return Optimizer is an online agricultural tool that helps calculate planting parameters and yield.
